description: This file is an Angular component for the parts page in a manufacturing equipment maintenance suite. It manages the display, creation, editing, and deletion of parts, and interacts with an API service to perform CRUD operations.

classes.name: PartsPageComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for managing parts within the application, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting parts.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of parts from the API and updates the parts state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Resets the form for creating a new part and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with data from an existing part and opens the modal for editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new or edited part by sending data to the API, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a part by its ID and refreshes the list.

methods.name: lowStock
methods.description: Determines if a part has low stock based on quantity and reorder point.

ctags.name: partsState
ctags.pattern: /^  protected readonly partsState = signal<HttpState<Part[]>>({ loading: false, data: [] });$/

fields.name: protected readonly partsState = signal<HttpState<Part[]>>({ loading: false, data: [] });
